runs.subject: Maths
runs.source_text: A circle has a centre. The radius is the distance from the centre to the edge. The diameter goes across the circle through the centre and is twice the radius. The circumference is the distance around the circle.

  <desc>Educational scientific illustration for GCSE learners showing the centre, radius, diameter, and circumference of a circle, with precise geometric specifications.</desc>

  <style>
    text {
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;

      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      fill: #8FA58A;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;

      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;

      animation: dashMove 4s infinite linear;

  <!-- Background Canvas -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="960" height="640" fill="#F7F4E9" />

  <!-- Top-left Concept Heading -->
  <text x="56" y="68" class="heading">Parts of a circle</text>
  <text x="58" y="94" class="sublabel">GCSE Mathematics Core Geometry</text>

  <!-- Ambient background accent -->
  <circle cx="480" cy="340" r="195" fill="#C8D96B" fill-opacity="0.08" />

  <!-- Main Circle (Exact geometric specification required: R=180) -->
  <circle id="main_circle" cx="480" cy="340" r="180" fill="#C8D96B" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="3" />

  <!-- Animated Circumference Boundary Tracer -->
  <circle cx="480" cy="340" r="180" fill="none" stroke="#8FA58A" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-dasharray="8, 12" class="marching-border" />

  <!-- Diameter Line (Exact specification required: horizontal spanning through centre) -->
  <line id="diameter_line" x1="300" y1="340" x2="660" y2="340" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Radius Line (Exact specification required: centre 480,340 to 607,213, radius = 180, with mandatory opacity pulse) -->
  <line id="radius_line" x1="480" y1="340" x2="607" y2="213" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.4;1;0.4" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </line>

  <!-- Circle Centre Point (Exact specification required) -->
  <circle id="circle_centre" cx="480" cy="340" r="5" fill="#244638" />

  <!-- Perimeter Anchor Points -->
  <circle cx="607" cy="213" r="4" fill="#244638" />
  <circle cx="607" cy="467" r="4" fill="#244638" />

  <!-- Circumference Callout Leader Line (Exact specification required) -->
  <line x1="607" y1="467" x2="720" y2="520" stroke="#8FA58A" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Formula Callout Box (Exact specification required) -->
  <rect x="700" y="160" width="200" height="80" rx="6" fill="#F7F4E9" stroke="#8FA58A" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="725" y="190" class="formula-title">Diameter formula</text>
  <text x="765" y="222" class="formula-val">d = 2r</text>

  <!-- Labels and Leader Annotations -->
  <!-- Centre Label -->
  <text x="450" y="380" class="label">Centre</text>
  <line x1="450" y1="368" x2="475" y2="345" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Radius Label -->
  <text x="550" y="260" class="label">Radius (r)</text>

  <!-- Diameter Label -->
  <text x="380" y="325" class="label">Diameter (2r)</text>

  <!-- Circumference Label -->
  <text x="730" y="525" class="label">Circumference</text>

</svg>

runs.subject: Physics
runs.source_text: In a series circuit there is only one loop. The current is the same everywhere in the loop. The voltage of the cell is shared between the components.
runs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="960" height="640" viewBox="0 0 960 640">
  <title>Series Circuit GCSE Physics Diagram</title>
  <desc>A precise scientific illustration of a series circuit showing a single loop, current flow, shared voltage, and a cell.</desc>

  <style>
    .bg { fill: #F7F4E9; }
    .heading { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1D2C25; }
    .label { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; fill: #1D2C25; font-weight: 500; }
    .subtext { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #8FA58A; }
    .wire { stroke: #244638; stroke-width: 4; fill: none; }
    .flow { stroke: #C8D96B; stroke-width: 4; fill: none; stroke-dasharray: 16, 24; }
    .callout-line { stroke: #8FA58A; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 4, 4; fill: none; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background Canvas -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="960" height="640" class="bg" />

  <!-- Main Topic Heading -->
  <text x="48" y="55" class="heading" textLength="210" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Series Circuit</text>

  <!-- Circuit Diagram Group -->
  <g id="circuit">
    <!-- Base Wire Loop -->
    <rect id="circuit_loop" x="180" y="160" width="600" height="320" rx="16" class="wire" />

    <!-- Animated Current Flow Overlay (Path-following stroke-dashoffset) -->
    <rect x="180" y="160" width="600" height="320" rx="16" class="flow">
      <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" from="0" to="-80" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </rect>

    <!-- DC Cell / Battery -->
    <g id="battery">
      <rect x="156" y="285" width="48" height="70" fill="#F7F4E9" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="2" rx="4" />
      <line x1="168" y1="305" x2="192" y2="305" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="4" />
      <line x1="174" y1="320" x2="186" y2="320" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="2" />
      <line x1="168" y1="335" x2="192" y2="335" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="4" />
      <line x1="174" y1="350" x2="186" y2="350" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="2" />
      <text x="136" y="278" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#244638">+</text>
      <text x="140" y="380" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#244638">-</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Series Component: Lamp 1 -->
    <g id="lamp1">
      <circle cx="380" cy="160" r="18" fill="#F7F4E9" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="3" />
      <line x1="367" y1="147" x2="393" y2="173" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="2" />
      <line x1="393" y1="147" x2="367" y2="173" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="2" />
    </g>

    <!-- Series Component: Lamp 2 -->
    <g id="lamp2">
      <circle cx="580" cy="160" r="18" fill="#F7F4E9" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="3" />
      <line x1="567" y1="147" x2="593" y2="173" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="2" />
      <line x1="593" y1="147" x2="567" y2="173" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="2" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Explanatory Labels & Callouts -->
  <g id="annotations">
    <!-- Cell Callout -->
    <line x1="130" y1="320" x2="156" y2="320" class="callout-line" />
    <text x="60" y="315" class="label">Cell</text>
    <text x="60" y="333" class="subtext">Power source</text>

    <!-- Top Current Callout -->
    <line x1="320" y1="110" x2="320" y2="160" class="callout-line" />
    <text x="240" y="100" class="label">Current is the same everywhere</text>

    <!-- Component Voltage Callout -->
    <line x1="480" y1="110" x2="480" y2="160" class="callout-line" />
    <text x="445" y="85" class="label">Voltage is shared between components</text>

    <!-- Bottom Loop Callout -->
    <line x1="480" y1="480" x2="480" y2="535" class="callout-line" />
    <text x="390" y="555" class="label">Only one closed loop</text>
  </g>

</svg>

runs.subject: Biology
runs.source_text: Plants take in carbon dioxide and water. They use light energy, absorbed by chlorophyll, to make glucose and oxygen.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="960" height="640" viewBox="0 0 960 640">
  <title>Photosynthesis Process Diagram</title>
  <desc>A scientific illustration showing how plants use light energy, carbon dioxide, and water to produce glucose and oxygen.</desc>

  <style>
    text {
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      fill: #1D2C25;

      font-size: 28px;

      font-size: 15px;

      stroke-dasharray: 10 8;

      from {

      to {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;

  <!-- Topic Heading -->

  <!-- Central Leaf & Internal Structures -->

runs.subject: Chemistry
runs.source_text: In a solid the particles are close together and vibrate in place. In a liquid they are close but move past each other. In a gas they are far apart and move fast.

  <title>States of Matter</title>
  <desc>Scientific illustration showing the arrangement and motion of particles in solids, liquids, and gases for GCSE Chemistry students.</desc>

  <style>
    .bg { fill: #F7F4E9; }
    .heading { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1D2C25; }
    .container-label { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #244638; text-anchor: middle; }

    .solid-p { fill: #244638; }
    .liquid-p { fill: #8FA58A; }
    .gas-p { fill: #C8D96B; stroke: #244638; stroke-width: 2; }
    .boundary { fill: #F7F4E9; stroke: #244638; stroke-width: 2.5; rx: 12; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="960" height="640" class="bg" />

  <!-- Main Topic Heading -->
  <text x="50" y="70" class="heading" textLength="240" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">States of Matter</text>

  <!-- Subheading / Context -->
  <text x="50" y="95" class="desc-text" textLength="500" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Particle arrangement and movement in solids, liquids, and gases.</text>

  <!-- ==================== SOLID CONTAINER & PARTICLES ==================== -->
  <rect id="solid_container" x="50" y="140" width="260" height="280" class="boundary" />
  <text x="180" y="175" class="container-label" textLength="55" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Solid</text>

  <!-- Solid Particles (3x4 lattice = 12 particles, vibrating in place) -->
  <!-- Row 1 -->
  <circle cx="110" cy="220" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="110;113;107;110" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="150" cy="220" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="220;222;218;220" dur="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>

  <circle cx="150" cy="270" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="150;153;147;150" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="190" cy="270" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="270;268;272;270" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="230" cy="270" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="230;227;233;230" dur="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>

  <!-- Row 3 -->

  <circle cx="150" cy="320" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="320;322;318;320" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="190" cy="320" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="190;193;187;190" dur="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="230" cy="320" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="320;318;322;320" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>

  <text x="480" y="175" class="container-label" textLength="60" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Liquid</text>

  <!-- Liquid Particles (Close, moving past each other) -->

  <circle cx="390" cy="320" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="390;405;390" dur="3.3s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="435" cy="325" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="325;310;325" dur="2.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="475" cy="320" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="475;460;475" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="520" cy="325" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="520;535;520" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>

  <!-- ==================== GAS CONTAINER & PARTICLES ==================== -->
  <rect id="gas_container" x="650" y="140" width="260" height="280" class="boundary" />
  <text x="780" y="175" class="container-label" textLength="35" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Gas</text>

  <!-- Gas Particles (Far apart, moving fast in random directions) -->
  <circle cx="690" cy="205" r="14" class="gas-p">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="690;820;710;690" dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="205;280;360;205" dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />

  <circle cx="840" cy="215" r="14" class="gas-p">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="840;690;860;840" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="215;350;230;215" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <circle cx="740" cy="300" r="14" class="gas-p">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="740;860;680;740" dur="2.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="300;190;330;300" dur="2.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <circle cx="820" cy="360" r="14" class="gas-p">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="820;700;840;820" dur="2.0s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="360;210;180;360" dur="2.0s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>


  <!-- ==================== EXPLANATORY CALLOUTS (BOTTOM) ==================== -->
  <!-- Solid Callout -->
  <line x1="60" y1="460" x2="300" y2="460" stroke="#8FA58A" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="60" y="480" class="callout-text" textLength="200" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Particles close together</text>
  <text x="60" y="505" class="desc-text" textLength="210" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">and fixed in a regular lattice.</text>
  <text x="60" y="525" class="desc-text" textLength="160" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Particles vibrate in place.</text>

  <!-- Liquid Callout -->
  <line x1="360" y1="460" x2="600" y2="460" stroke="#8FA58A" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="360" y="480" class="callout-text" textLength="200" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Particles close, moving past</text>
  <text x="360" y="505" class="desc-text" textLength="180" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">each other with no fixed</text>
  <text x="360" y="525" class="desc-text" textLength="75" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">structure.</text>

  <!-- Gas Callout -->
  <line x1="660" y1="460" x2="900" y2="460" stroke="#8FA58A" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="660" y="480" class="callout-text" textLength="160" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Particles far apart</text>
  <text x="660" y="505" class="desc-text" textLength="190" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">and move fast in random</text>
  <text x="660" y="525" class="desc-text" textLength="70" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">directions.</text>

</svg>

runs.source_text: A circle has a centre. The radius is the distance from the centre to the edge. The diameter goes across the circle through the centre and is twice the radius. The circumference is the distance around the circle.
